portion_doctrine: Earn Your Leisure podcast episodes extracted from transcript. Multiple deep business/finance/tech conversations spanning grants, NFTs, AI tools, music entrepreneurship, and wealth-building strategies.
gold_highlights: Grant-writing formula: 10% win rate baseline, reverse-engineer funder rubrics via unpaid.com judges role to understand selection criteria

AI toolbox for entrepreneurs: Lovable ($20/mo landing pages), HeyGen ($29+ AI avatars), Perplexity (research), Claude/ChatGPT (writing), Zapier agents (automation), Veo3 (video generation), total overhead ~$200-240/month

NFT utility layers: V Friends model - NFT as event ticket (3-year conference pass), Series 2 trading card boxes, Gift Goat (physical product fulfillment via blockchain), loyalty tracking on immutable ledger

Music streaming flips: Proof-of-concept via social media before playlist push; Rap Caviar is overvalued; TikTok/Reels drive chart performance now, not playlists; focus on niche audience cultivation over algorithm chase
operating_rules: Grant strategy: Apply 1 grant per day targeting different funders; win rate ~10% so 30 apps = 3 wins/month; federal/state require 6-month planning; corporate grants 30-45 day funding window

AI accuracy: Set custom instructions in ChatGPT/Claude to ban hypothetical stories; use Perplexity for sourced research; verify via deep research button; hallucinations drop 80% with proper guardrails
Music tour/show strategy: Build own audience via touring, not club soft money; clubs are transactional (song must be hot); church events similarly broken; independent touring builds durable fan base

Proof of concept mandatory: Focus groups with 100-500 fans before scaling; test market via social media reels; market changes every 6-12 months (Metro tag fatigue example); keep younger people on team for culture signal

prompts: For grant research: 'I need a grant for [purpose] in [location/field]. Show me the last 6 months of funding by [funder name]. What was the average award? What industries? What's the message that wins?'
For video script: 'I have an influencer avatar. Write me a UGC product placement script for [product]. She is [age/gender]. Make it sound like her speaking, not an ad. Keep to 30 seconds.'
For book extraction: 'Convert this [podcast transcript] to an ebook with worksheets, action guides, checklists. Output 200+ pages in one continuous stream.' (Claude Opus + Extended Thinking)
For fashion trend analysis: 'Give me 40 years of clothing cycles: baggy-tight-baggy-tight. Predict the next cycle. When will tight jeans come back? [for investment thesis]'

For real estate research: 'Search for available investment properties in [zip code]. Include current listings, prices, property types, rental rates by bedroom, market duration by category, days-on-market trends.'
For market validation: 'Rank these 6 songs. Why would you listen to song #3? What's the hook? Would you send to a friend?'
